item.title: Harness Engineering
item.summary: Harness Engineering 的价值控制点不是单次 benchmark，而是把离线回归、生产 trace、在线评估、人工校准、故障恢复、A/B 优化和成本账本连成同一任务身份下的闭环。外部玩家已形成模型原生、云控制面、数据/ML 平台、独立工程平台与业务入口五类经营路径；真实客服案例证明局部结果，但跨玩家线上失败下降、恢复时长、评估覆盖和每成功任务经济仍未知，因此阶段只能判 pilot。

counterevidence: 生产研究显示 68% 的 Agent 在最多 10 步后需要人工，74% 主要依赖人工评估，可靠性仍是首要难题。
Microsoft 外部 Agent 仍不支持人工评估、trace 转数据集和 AI 红队。
Databricks 生产监控仍为 Beta，存在采样、20 scorer 上限和 notebook 限制。
Snowflake 明示 ground-truth staleness，带 MCP connector 的 Agent 评估尚不支持。
MIT Index 显示 agent-specific safety eval、内部结果和第三方测试披露稀缺。
安全媒体报道的沙箱突破只作事故线索，说明恢复和权限隔离不能被 benchmark 替代。

huawei_implications: 本轮仅研究外部玩家与行业机制，不评估华为内部经营、资源、客户或执行。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来 12–36 个月，通用 tracing 和 LLM-as-judge 会商品化，价值将转向拥有真实失败语料、专家反馈、版本/回滚权、业务结果和成本归因的平台。若 evaluator 无法校准、生产抽样有盲区或恢复不能闭环，Harness 只会增加观测成本而不会形成经营杠杆。
synthesis.strategic_summary: Harness Engineering 的价值控制点不是单次 benchmark，而是把离线回归、生产 trace、在线评估、人工校准、故障恢复、A/B 优化和成本账本连成同一任务身份下的闭环。外部玩家已形成模型原生、云控制面、数据/ML 平台、独立工程平台与业务入口五类经营路径；真实客服案例证明局部结果，但跨玩家线上失败下降、恢复时长、评估覆盖和每成功任务经济仍未知，因此阶段只能判 pilot。
synthesis.why_now: AWS 已把 Evaluations 与 Optimization 独立计费，Anthropic/OpenAI、Databricks、LangSmith 和 Microsoft 均把生产 trace 与回归评估产品化；与此同时，生产研究、Snowflake/Databricks/Microsoft 限制、MIT 透明度审计和沙箱漏洞显示可靠性闭环尚未成熟。
winner_conditions: 同一 run/task identity 贯通输入、模型、工具、状态、评估、业务结果和成本
冻结回归集、盲测集、线上抽样、人工校准与 A/B 共同验收
故障有分类、隔离、回滚、幂等、补偿和人工升级 SLO
evaluator 版本、偏差、漂移、覆盖和误报漏报可审计
把每成功任务全成本、返工、人工接管和事故纳入发布门
用 30/90 日 retained workflow 与续费验证质量改进的经营价值

evidence.source_quote: In our testing_criteria , we define how we will conclude if the model output satisfies our requirements for each item in the data set. In this case, we just want the model to output one of three category strings based on the input ticket. The string it outputs should exactly match the human-labeled correct_label field in our test data. So in this case, we will want to use a string_check grader to evaluate the output.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: OpenAI Evals 文档提供数据集、grader、迭代和回归测试的正式产品边界。

evidence.source_quote: These methods map to different stages of agent development. Automated evals are especially useful pre-launch and in CI/CD, running on each agent change and model upgrade as the first line of defense against quality problems. Production monitoring kicks in post-launch to detect distribution drift and unanticipated real-world failures. A/B testing validates significant changes once you have sufficient traffic. User feedback and transcript review are ongoing practices to fill the gaps: triage feedback constantly, sample transcripts to read weekly, and dig deeper as needed. Reserve systematic human studies for calibrating LLM graders or evaluating subjective outputs where human consensus serves as the reference standard.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic 将离线评估、生产监控、用户反馈和人工复核组合为 Agent 质量闭环，回答 Harness 的评估控制点。

evidence.source_quote: LangSmith Evaluation lets you evaluate agent performance, grounded in real production trace data and aligned to human judgment:
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: LangSmith 将 trace、在线/离线评估、成本和延迟监控做成框架无关 Agent 工程平台。

evidence.source_quote: Ground truth staleness can make evaluation results drift over time; agents with MCP connectors are not currently supported by Cortex Agent evaluations.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake 官方限制显示工具连接器与完整评估闭环仍有断点，防止把托管能力误判成熟。

evidence.source_quote: Built-in evaluators input tokens $0.0024 per 1,000; output tokens $0.012 per 1,000; custom evaluators $1.50 per 1,000 evaluations; batch evaluations $0.0018 per 1,000 input tokens and $0.009 per 1,000 output tokens.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS 官方价格揭示连续评估、定制 evaluator、采样、A/B 测试和观测的实际计费单位与成本控制。

evidence.source_quote: Customer satisfaction increased from approximately 3.9 to 5.0 on a five-point scale. Answer quality improved from approximately 57 to 95.5 percent; the flow includes structured escalation to human-assisted workflows.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tiendas CUADRA 提供真实客服流程中的多 Agent 编排、人工边界和生产采用证据。

evidence.source_quote: The evaluation and monitoring component of MLflow 3 is designed to help you iteratively optimize the quality of your GenAI app. Evaluation and monitoring build upon MLflow Tracing , which provides real-time trace logging in the development, testing, and production phases. Traces can be evaluated during development using built-in or custom LLM judges and scorers , and production monitoring can reuse the same judges and scorers, ensuring consistent evaluation throughout the application lifecycle. Domain experts can provide feedback using an integrated Review App for collecting human feedback, producing evaluation data for further iteration.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Databricks/MLflow 统一开发评估、生产监控、Tracing 和领域专家反馈，代表数据平台型 Harness。

evidence.source_quote: Most safety-related fields (135/240) have no public information; only four of 30 agents provide agent-specific safety evaluations, 25/30 disclose no internal safety results, and 23/30 disclose no third-party testing information.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MIT Agent Index 的披露、评估和安全透明度缺口限制了平台自述的可比较性。

evidence.source_quote: Production monitoring evaluates a configurable sample of traces. At most 20 scorers can be associated with an experiment, and custom scorers must be defined and registered from a Databricks notebook.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MLflow 生产监控的 beta、采样、scorer 数量和 notebook 序列化限制反证端到端成熟度。

evidence.source_quote: What can you build with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore?
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AgentCore 总览把 session/trace/span 评估、OpenTelemetry 观测和生产质量信号放入同一控制平面。

evidence.source_quote: Across 306 practitioners and 20 case-study interviews, 68% of production agents execute at most 10 steps before human intervention, 74% depend primarily on human evaluation, and reliability remains the top development challenge.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: ICML 生产 Agent 研究的完整论文用于核验短链、人工评估依赖与可靠性难题，替代摘要页。

evidence.source_quote: Current limitations: Human evaluation, trace-to-dataset conversion, and AI red teaming are not currently supported for externally registered agents.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft 可把跨云 Agent 纳入 trace 与评估，但外部 Agent 仍不支持人工评估、trace 转数据集和红队，限制平台完整性。

evidence.source_quote: This involves loading the Linux kernel's "act_pedit" Traffic Control (tc) packet editing subsystem into an unprivileged user namespace and exploiting CVE-2026-46331 in the guest kernel, a recently disclosed flaw called pedit COW, to obtain guest-root. From there, the agent can access the whole host ("/") with elevated privileges, allowing it to read or write files from and to the Mac's file system as the logged-in desktop user.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 专业安全媒体的 Agent 沙箱与提示注入报道作为故障恢复、权限隔离和红队缺口的反证线索。

evidence.source_quote: The $200 million multi-year agreement makes Claude available to more than 12,600 Snowflake customers; Snowflake reports greater than 90% accuracy on complex text-to-SQL tasks from internal benchmarks and cites Intercom production use.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Snowflake/Anthropic 的生产客户披露补充受治理数据、跨模型运行和客户 Agent 规模，但保持联合厂商自述边界。
